cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to win that swimming medal. Now let the charity auction have it; you're ready to be known for something bigger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only race I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you finally believe it counts. Good. You don't need the metal to keep the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it instead? I want people to see my name on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Present it to the buyer yourself. Use the clear voice we practised at prize-giving; nobody will miss whose medal it was.

reason: Make A claimed training support giving up proof of the achievement, then use B wish for recognition to offer a public surrender performance.
